result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. The bug was in the merge condition at src/lib.rs:54. 

**The issue:** The merge logic used `s.start < last.end`, which only merges overlapping spans but not touching ones (where `s.start == last.end`).

**The fix:** Changed the condition to `s.start <= last.end` so that spans that touch are also merged together.

This allows the `merges_touching_spans` test to pass by correctly merging spans [1,4) and [4,6) into [1,6).
